sinPantallas: Your role has no screens available. Ask an administrator to review your permissions.

inventario.ayudaCantidadBaja: How many units leave the inventory. At most the batch balance ({{max}}).
inventario.ayudaMotivoBaja: Required. Why it leaves the inventory (expired, damaged, lost…). Recorded with your user.

clientes.confirmDesactivar: Deactivate {{nombre}}? They will no longer appear in lists (history is kept).
clientes.nota: ID type and number go together or both stay empty. To open a rental the customer needs a phone number.
clientes.buscar: Search by name, ID or phone

proveedores.buscar: Search by name or tax ID

usuarios.claveCorta: Password must be at least 10 characters
usuarios.claveNuevaCorta: The new password must be at least 10 characters
usuarios.confirmDesactivar: Deactivate {{nombre}}? Their session is closed immediately and they will not be able to log in.
usuarios.ayudaUsuario: Name used to log in. Must be unique (case-insensitive).
usuarios.ayudaClave: At least 10 characters. Hand it over through a secure channel and ask them to change it on first login.
usuarios.ayudaRol: Defines what the user can do. You can only assign roles below your own level.
usuarios.ayudaClaveNueva: At least 10 characters. The person's current session is not closed; they must use the new password next time.
usuarios.ayudaClaveNuevaMia: At least 10 characters and different from the current one.

catalogo.minimoSinPrecio: To set the minimum stock, also enter the sale price
catalogo.creadoHabilitado: Product created and enabled in this branch
catalogo.creadoSinPrecio: Product created. It still needs a price before it can be bought and sold.
catalogo.confirmCat: Deactivate category {{nombre}}? It will no longer be offered when creating products.
catalogo.ayudaCategoriaNombre: Group used to organize products (e.g. Cleaning, Tools). You pick one when creating a product.
catalogo.ayudaManejaCaducidad: Check it if products in this category expire (food, medicine). Expiry dates of their batches are tracked.
catalogo.ayudaCategoria: Group the product belongs to. If the category tracks expiry, its batches are tracked by expiry date.
catalogo.ayudaCodigo: Unique product code (yours or your supplier's). It cannot be repeated.
catalogo.ayudaNombre: Name shown in sales, purchases and inventory.
catalogo.ayudaMedida: How the product is counted: bottle, bag, box, unit…
catalogo.ayudaIva: VAT percentage that applies to this product (e.g. 0, 5 or 19).
catalogo.ayudaPrecioVenta: Selling price at the branch selected above. You can leave it empty and set it later.
catalogo.ayudaStockMinimo: Minimum quantity you want to keep. Below it, inventory flags the product as low stock.

notasCredito.nota: A credit note is created from a confirmed sale (button inside the sale).

catalogoRenta.ayudaCategoria: Group it belongs to (e.g. Ladders, Tools). If it does not exist, create it in the form above.
catalogoRenta.ayudaCodigo: Short unique identifier of the product (e.g. TAL). Pieces are numbered from it: TAL-001, TAL-002…
catalogoRenta.ayudaSeCobraPor: Time unit of the rate (hour, day…). Rentals are charged by whole periods.
catalogoRenta.ayudaTarifa: Cost of each period (hour, day…) per piece, before VAT.
catalogoRenta.ayudaIva: Tax percentage added to the rate. Use 0 if it does not apply.
catalogoRenta.ayudaDeposito: Security money the customer leaves per piece. It is returned when the piece comes back, or deducted from what they owe.
catalogoRenta.ayudaReposicion: Cost of replacing a piece if it is lost. Stored as a reference.
catalogoRenta.ayudaPiezas: How many physical pieces to create now in the selected branch, with automatic codes (TAL-001, TAL-002…). You can leave it empty and add them later.
catalogoRenta.buscarPieza: Search piece by code or name

rentas.errorCantidad: Choose the quantity of at least one product
rentas.sinPiezas: There are no available pieces in this branch. Add them in
rentas.buscarCliente: Search customer by name, ID or phone…
rentas.ayudaCliente: Search by name, ID or phone. They must have a phone number and not be blocked.
rentas.ayudaDevolucion: Date and time the items are due back. After that time, the rental is considered overdue.

expl.ventas: Confirmed sales for the period. "Returned" is what credit notes refunded and "Net" is what actually remains.
expl.margenes: Profit per product: what was sold minus the real cost of the batches it came from.
expl.stock-bajo: Products whose available stock (excluding expired) is at or below the minimum.
expl.por-vencer: Batches with balance that expire soon or already expired, with the value at risk.
expl.cuadre: Inventory integrity check: it should show no mismatches.

informes.ayudaDesde: First day of the period. If you leave from and to empty, the last 30 days are shown.
informes.ayudaVencenEn: Shows batches expiring within this number of days, and also those already expired.
informes.todoCuadra: Everything matches: each batch balance agrees with its movement history.
informes.hayDescuadres: {{n}} batch(es) do not match. Let technical support know.

compraDetalle.confirmRecibir: Receive the purchase? Stock enters the inventory and lines can no longer be changed.
compraDetalle.recibida: Purchase received: stock is now in the inventory
compraDetalle.confirmAnular: Void the purchase? The stock that came in is deducted.
compraDetalle.precioVenta: Sale price (this product has none yet)
compraDetalle.nota: If the product has no price in this branch yet, you set it right here. Expiry is required if the product tracks it.
compraDetalle.buscarProducto: Search product by name, code or barcode…

ventaDetalle.confirmConfirmar: Confirm the sale? Stock goes out and the lines can no longer be changed.
ventaDetalle.buscarProducto: Search product by name, code or barcode…

notaDetalle.confirmConfirmar: Confirm the credit note? Lines can no longer be changed.
notaDetalle.totalFavor: Total in favor of the customer
notaDetalle.notaReembolso: Returning to stock is only for items that come back in good condition. The money is refunded separately.
notaDetalle.pendiente: Pending to refund to the customer: {{valor}}.
notaDetalle.sinPendiente: There is no money pending to refund.

cobro.texto: The customer pays money for what they owe. Money goes into the cash register.

aplicacion_deposito.texto: No new money comes in: what the customer owes is paid with the deposit they left.

devolucion_deposito.texto: The remaining deposit is handed back to the customer. Money leaves the cash register.

d.piezasAyuda: Sum of the pieces already returned, based on the periods used and their rate.
d.cargosAyuda: Additional charges for damage, delays, cleaning, etc.
d.pagadoDineroAyuda: What the customer has paid directly (cash, transfer, card…).
d.pagadoDepositoAyuda: Part of the account paid using the deposit the customer left.
d.saldoAyuda: What the customer still owes. It must be 0 to close.
d.recibidoAyuda: Deposit the customer left when the rental was opened.
d.usadoAyuda: Part of the deposit deducted from what they owed.
d.devueltoAyuda: Deposit that has already been handed back.
d.enPoderAyuda: Deposit you still hold and must return or use to pay. It must be 0 to close.

rentaDetalle.confirmCerrar: Close the rental? It can no longer be modified.
rentaDetalle.confirmCancelar: Cancel the rental? This is only possible if no piece has been returned.
rentaDetalle.guiaPendientes: {{n}} piece(s) still to be returned. Register how each one came back in the pieces table.
rentaDetalle.guiaUsarDepositoTodo: You can use their deposit ({{valor}}) to pay it.
rentaDetalle.guiaUsarDepositoResto: You can use their deposit ({{valor}}) to pay it and charge the rest.
rentaDetalle.guiaSaldada: The account is settled. The customer’s deposit still has to be returned: {{valor}}.
rentaDetalle.guiaListo: Everything is settled and the deposit is at zero. You can now close the rental.
rentaDetalle.reqDeposito: Deposit returned or used (nothing left held)
rentaDetalle.notaPiezas: Register how each piece came back: in good condition it becomes available again; damaged goes to maintenance; lost is withdrawn.
rentaDetalle.notaCargos: Additional charges for damage, delays, cleaning… They are added to the total to pay.
rentaDetalle.ayudaPieza: The piece the charge belongs to.
rentaDetalle.ayudaMotivoCargo: Type of charge: damage, delay, cleaning… They are managed in the rental catalog.
rentaDetalle.ayudaMontoCargo: Extra value added to the total to pay, on top of the rented time.
rentaDetalle.ayudaMetodo: How the money is received or handed over.
rentaDetalle.ayudaMontoMov: Value of this movement. It cannot exceed the maximum shown.
rentaDetalle.ayudaReferencia: Transfer number, voucher or note to identify the movement.
rentaDetalle.cancelarNota: Cancelling is only possible if no piece has been returned.

ventas.clientePh: Customer: name, ID or phone (empty = walk-in customer)
ventas.ayudaVendedor: Filter sales by the person who recorded them. Only owner and manager see it.
